title: A flow collection directly after the colon of an explicit plain key
notes: An explicit entry `? key` is production 143. Its optional value is production 144, which is production 147 again: the `:` must be followed by white space before a value node. Only a JSON-like key, such as a quoted one, may have its value right after the `:` (production 149); the plain key `a` is not one. In `{? a:{}}` the `:` is followed by `{`, which is not plain-safe in a flow collection, so `a` ends at the colon and the colon is the indicator. The entry then has an empty value and must end with `,` or `}`, so the second `{`, at column 6, cannot belong to any valid document (the same rule that gives column 4 for `{a:{}}`). Compare diagnostics/plain-key-with-adjacent-flow-value-is-invalid.

provenance.reference: Found while reading the source of a library whose flow mapping reader applied the adjacent-value rule to implicit keys but not to the key of an explicit `?` entry.
